title: 第288章周主任找过来
slug: 临时加彩礼转头另娶绝美女知青
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“不用，媳妇儿，我一个人去就行了。

我去了就单纯的送个货，没别的事情。

上午到市里送完货之后，下午我就回来，尽量不在市里耽误。”

见陈卫东不让自己去，林婉秋也就没勉强。

而且自己跟着一道去了，确实帮不上什么忙。

她这晕车的身体，指不定还会成为他男人的拖累呢。

这么想着，林婉秋更觉得自己不能跟着一道过去。

考虑到明天要去市里，晚上陈卫东就早些休息了。

当然，能早点休息的原因和他媳妇儿来月经有关系。

要是这妮子没来月经，晚上的造娃任务陈卫东可不会落下。

第二天一早，陈卫东在家吃过早饭，便去了制衣厂那边拿了货。

二十套衣服送去县供销社，剩下的一百套衣服送去市供销社。

这次送去市供销社的，还有一百二十多头花。

但凡买了他们红旗生产队制衣厂衣服的，都能附带送一朵头花。

这么多套服装，陈卫东足足扛了两个麻袋。

他到了县里后，先去把给县供销社那边的货送了过去，随后才去了汽车站。

等上午十一点，陈卫东到达了市里。

到了市里后，陈卫东先把货送去了第一家合作的供销社。

看到陈卫东这次送来的一百套服装的款式和质量，这家供销社主任觉得很惊喜。

原本他还以为，陈卫东上次和他谈合作，拿的成品样衣是他们厂子做的最好的衣服。

结果陈卫东这次送来的货，竟然比他上次拿的样衣更好看。

这家供销社主任便预感销售量应该不会太差。

毕竟他觉得市百货大楼的衣服也没陈卫东送来的这些衣服好看，只要东西好，就不用愁着卖不出。

尤其是陈卫东还送来了一批头花，买衣服就能送头花，对不少顾客都有吸引力。

这家供销社主任检查了货品，陈卫东让他签了签收单，等着下次再送货的时候，和对方结账。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"No, wife, I can go alone.

I just went to deliver the goods, nothing else.

After I went to the city to deliver the goods in the morning, I came back in the afternoon and tried not to delay in the city."

Seeing that Chen Weidong wouldn't let her go, Lin Wanqiu didn't force herself.

And I went along with him, so I really couldn't help much.

Her motion-sick body might even become a drag on his man.

Thinking like this, Lin Wanqiu felt that she couldn't go with them.

Considering that he was going to the city tomorrow, Chen Weidong went to bed early in the evening.

Of course, the reason why he was able to rest early had something to do with his wife's menstruation.

If this girl hadn't had her period, Chen Weidong would not have missed the task of making a baby in the evening.

Early the next morning, Chen Weidong had breakfast at home and then went to the garment factory to pick up the goods.

Twenty sets of clothes were sent to the county supply and marketing cooperative, and the remaining 100 sets of clothes were sent to the city supply and marketing cooperative.

This time, there were more than 120 flowers sent to the city supply and marketing cooperative.

Anyone who buys clothes from their Hongqi Production Team Garment Factory will receive a flower as a gift.

With so many sets of clothing, Chen Weidong carried two sacks.

After he arrived at the county, he first delivered the goods to the county supply and marketing cooperative, and then went to the bus station.

At eleven o'clock in the morning, Chen Weidong arrived in the city.

After arriving in the city, Chen Weidong first sent the goods to the first cooperative supply and marketing cooperative.

The director of the supply and marketing cooperative was pleasantly surprised when he saw the style and quality of the 100 sets of clothing sent by Chen Weidong this time.

Originally, he thought that the finished sample clothes Chen Weidong got when he discussed cooperation with him last time were the best clothes made by their factory.

As a result, the goods Chen Weidong sent this time turned out to be better-looking than the sample clothes he got last time.

The director of this supply and marketing cooperative had a hunch that the sales volume would not be too bad.

After all, he felt that the clothes in the city department store were not as good-looking as the clothes sent by Chen Weidong. As long as the goods were good, there was no need to worry about not being able to sell them.

In particular, Chen Weidong also sent a batch of hair flowers. You can get hair flowers when you buy clothes, which is attractive to many customers.

The director of the supply and marketing cooperative inspected the goods, and Chen Weidong asked him to sign the receipt and wait for the next delivery to settle the bill with the other party.
